description: llmux Reasoning & Reliability Upgrade - Improve reasoning/thinking support, reliability, and provider compatibility

userStories.title: Implement normalizeReasoningEffort helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want reasoning_effort values to be normalized per model so that invalid values don't cause 400 errors from OpenAI API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create normalizeReasoningEffort(model: string, effort?: string) function in packages/core/src/util/model-capabilities.ts
Support values: none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh
Model-specific support: gpt-5.1 (none default, low/medium/high), gpt-5-pro (high only), gpt-5.1-codex-max+ (all values)
Unsupported values fallback to model default

userStories.title: Integrate reasoning effort clamping into applyThinkingConfig
userStories.description: As a developer, I want OpenAI provider transformations to automatically clamp reasoning effort so that API calls succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract model name from unified request metadata or config
Handle case where model name is not available (use original value)

userStories.title: Define RetryPolicy type and getRetryPolicy helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want per-provider/model retry policies so that different endpoints can have different retry behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Define RetryPolicy interface: { maxAttempts: number; budgetCheckRequired: boolean }
Implement getRetryPolicy(provider: ProviderName, model?: string, deploymentId?: string) function

userStories.title: Implement zero-cost model detection
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to identify zero-cost models so that budget checks can be bypassed for free/internal models.
acceptanceCriteria: Add isZeroCostModel(model: string): boolean function in packages/core/src/util/model-capabilities.ts
Add ZERO_COST_MODELS allowlist (initially empty, can be extended)
Update getRetryPolicy to set budgetCheckRequired = false for zero-cost models

userStories.title: Strip thinking blocks from UnifiedRequest messages
userStories.description: As a developer, I want thinking blocks stripped from conversation history so that multi-turn requests don't leak previous turn's thinking.
acceptanceCriteria: Create stripThinkingFromMessages(messages: UnifiedMessage[]) helper in packages/core/src/util/thinking-utils.ts
Remove ContentPart with type: 'thinking' from all messages
Add unit tests with multi-turn conversation scenarios
userStories.notes: Reference: opencode-antigravity-auth Strip ALL thinking blocks strategy

userStories.title: Apply thinking strip in Anthropic request transformation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Anthropic requests to automatically strip thinking blocks so that signature errors are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply before building Anthropic messages array
Ensure UnifiedResponse.thinking only contains current response thinking
Add multi-turn test case verifying thinking isolation

userStories.title: Reset thinking state in AnthropicStreamingBuilder
userStories.description: As a developer, I want streaming thinking state to be per-response so that thinking doesn't carry over between streams.
acceptanceCriteria: Add currentThinkingBlocks: ThinkingBlock[] state to AnthropicStreamingBuilder
Only include currentThinkingBlocks in final accumulated result

userStories.title: Normalize thoughtSignature in Gemini response parsing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want thoughtSignature mapped to unified types so that signatures are consistently handled across providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Map thoughtSignature from Gemini parts to ContentPart.thoughtSignature
Copy to ThinkingBlock.signature when part is thinking type
Add unit tests with Gemini response containing thoughtSignature
userStories.notes: Reference: Antigravity API spec Thinking Response section

userStories.title: Normalize thoughtSignature in Antigravity response parsing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Antigravity (Claude via Google) thoughtSignature handled correctly for unified types.
acceptanceCriteria: Add unit tests with Antigravity Claude response
userStories.notes: Reference: Antigravity API spec Claude thinking response format

userStories.title: Enforce signature stripping in logging
userStories.description: As a developer, I want thoughtSignature stripped from all logs so that sensitive signatures are never exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify all logging entry points in packages/server that log UnifiedResponse or StreamChunk
Apply stripThoughtSignatures before logging (function already exists in @llmux/core)
Add test verifying log output contains no thoughtSignature strings

userStories.title: Implement streaming order normalizer
userStories.description: As a developer, I want reasoning-end events to occur before text-start so that streaming order is consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain per-block state: hasThinkingStarted, hasThinkingEnded, hasTextStarted
Insert synthetic thinking-end before first text-delta if thinking started but not ended

userStories.title: Integrate streaming normalizer into streaming builders
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all streaming builders to use the order normalizer so that event order is consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add integration tests verifying correct order across providers

userStories.title: Define BackoffStrategy interface and implementations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want provider-specific backoff strategies so that retry delays are optimized per provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Define BackoffStrategy interface: getDelayMs(context: { attempt, error?, headers? }): number
Implement AnthropicBackoffStrategy: exponential + jitter, respect Retry-After header
Implement GeminiBackoffStrategy: exponential, lower max delay
Add unit tests for each strategy

userStories.title: Implement Gemini image token estimation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want image tokens included in Gemini token counts so that usage is accurately tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: Base token count: 256 per image (or documented Gemini value)
Integrate into accumulateGeminiResponse for inputTokens calculation
Add tests: text only, text+1 image, text+2 images
